name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Dashboard now looks utilitarian, not AI — sharp .2em corners everywhere (native Jellyfin), no gradients/pills/glow. Replaced rounded hero with a plain H1 + fieldDescription, flat status strip, underline tabs instead of pills, and flat inputs (#292929). Added a new Catalog tab: search your own library by name, open a title, and set per-friend or per-user limits right there (exclude a title from a friend, or jump to People → that friend's user to restrict it to certain items). New Incoming content filters (also under Catalog) let you block what you'll even pull in from any friend — by item type (Movie/Series/etc), rating ceiling (G→NC-17 / TV-Y→TV-MA — unknown ratings pass through, not silently hidden), blocked tags and blocked genres — all ANDed, empty means allow everything so upgrading hides nothing. New download gates: a global switch plus per-friend and per-user toggles (browsing/streaming still works; only Download is blocked). Per-user rating ceilings on the friend's side (Jerry → Bob) now work even when Mode is 'All shared libraries'. Fixes: federation badge cloud is now a filled shape (reads at 12px, no hairlines) and RequestingRemoteUserId is handled on this branch. Sync fetch now requests OfficialRating/Genres/Tags so filters are enforceable. 223 tests.
